regional.headline: Lujo virus. Nosocomial haemorrhagic fever outbreak in southern Africa.
regional.geography: Lujo virus. Nosocomial haemorrhagic fever outbreak in southern Africa.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

vectors: Aedes mcintoshi (and other floodwater Aedes, with transovarial maintenance)
regional.syndrome: Most human infections are a self-limiting febrile illness. Complications: retinitis with permanent visual loss (1–10%), meningoencephalitis, and haemorrhagic fever with hepatic failure (<1%, but ~50% fatal).
regional.headline: Zoonotic phlebovirus causing devastating ruminant abortion storms and human haemorrhagic fever; a WHO priority pathogen.
regional.prevention: Livestock vaccination, movement controls, protective equipment during slaughter, vector control. No licensed human vaccine.
regional.geography: Sub-Saharan Africa, Madagascar, Egypt, Arabian peninsula; outbreaks follow heavy rainfall and flooding.
regional.evidence_note: Virus, viral RNA or specific antibody found in the reservoir host or in livestock, with no human case reported. The virus is present in the country; whether it has ever infected a person there is unknown.
